blockers.detail: The 80-task SDAB evaluation bundle is private. No public mirror, no dataset card, no revision identifier.
blockers.external_receipt_needed: Provider-issued bundle with a 40- or 64-hex immutable revision, the 80 task IDs, category and difficulty-variant labels, and a license identifier or evaluation-agreement reference.

blockers.detail: No train/eval split receipt exists. train_task_id_sha256 is null, so the runtime manifest cannot be emitted.
blockers.external_receipt_needed: Provider statement of the training/development/public task IDs (or an explicit 'no train split exists'), with an immutable reference.

blockers.detail: The live enterprise runtime with deterministic reset, running infrastructure, and traffic generator is private. The only failing preflight gate is the missing provider adapter module.
blockers.external_receipt_needed: Container digest, environment/seed digest, cloudbox provisioning path, and a module:factory adapter entrypoint exposing list_tasks/evaluate_task/verify_result.

blockers.detail: The grading harness (behavioral tests, engineering rubrics, LLM judge, hidden state validation) is private and sits outside the agent workspace by design.
blockers.external_receipt_needed: Verifier identity, revision, sha256, behavioral-test/rubric/state-validation digests, judge model and configuration, and the composite weighting.
blockers.gate_it_unblocks: result admissibility (every per-task score is discarded without it)

code_changes.change: REPO_ROOT was HERE.parents[2] (the directory ABOVE the checkout), which put the default isolated environment outside the worktree and made the isolation gate unsatisfiable. Now parents[1]; default environment root is outputs/e3_sdab/venv-sdab-e3.

Added provider-bundle ingestion: validate_task_bundle, newline_task_id_sha256, build_split_manifest, prove_split_disjointness, build_boundary_spec_from_bundle, build_runtime_manifest, ingest_task_bundle, build_ingest_receipt, plus synthetic-fixture rejection in build_sdab_boundary and a --bundle CLI mode.

Added 23 tests covering bundle schema validation, task-ID hashing (including cross-check against the runner's hash scheme), split-manifest determinism, disjointness proof, runtime-manifest emission accepted by validate_native_manifest, and receipt emission that can never carry a score.

cost.note: Projected maximum is for a 1-task slice at the configured token ceilings (max_actions=8, max_prompt_tokens=4096, max_response_tokens=256). A full 80-task run at those same ceilings projects to $1.634304, which already exceeds the $0.50 E3 suite cap. Separately, those ceilings are not realistic for SDAB: the provider states tasks run up to 12 hours on live infrastructure, so a real episode will use far more than 8 actions and 4096 prompt tokens. The budget model must be re-derived from the provider's actual scaffold and action budget before any paid run is authorized.

environment.tinker_source: public PyPI; no private index and no credential required

evidence_boundary: Local harness is complete up to the provider access boundary. No SDAB task data was obtained, no environment was launched, no grader was run, and no score exists.
not_blockers_anymore: tinker package availability in the isolated environment - resolved, public PyPI install
wandb availability in the isolated environment - resolved
isolated worktree environment gate - resolved by the REPO_ROOT fix plus outputs/e3_sdab/venv-sdab-e3

guarantees: every task ID carries the SYNTHETIC-NOT-SDAB marker
bundle sets synthetic=true; the adapter raises if flag and markers disagree
build_sdab_boundary refuses any spec carrying a synthetic marker
build_runtime_manifest refuses a synthetic ingest, so the fixture can never launch a run
ingest and receipt emit score=null and is_model_score=false in every mode

focused_tests.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=zvf-program outputs/e3_sdab/venv-sdab-e3/bin/python -m unittest -v flagship.test_pavlov_sdab_eval_adapter flagship.test_eval_pavlov_sdab

authoritative_path_refusal: boundary.source_revision='SYNTHETIC-NOT-SDAB-revision-0000' is a synthetic harness fixture and can never be used as authoritative SDAB evidence
